name: game-brainstorm
description: > Runs designer-led ideation that turns a mood, theme, genre or "something like X" into three original concepts and one chosen Game Concept Document with core loop, pillars, player fit and scope, plus 5-10 minute web or jam hooks. Use for "game idea", "brainstorm", "pitch", "what should I make", "a game like X". Not for market sizing (use game-market-research).
